EmailTemplate.name: Freight Sales Support Acknowledgement Email Template
EmailTemplate.subject: Your Qantas Freight Sales Support Case {!Case.CaseNumber}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Thank you for contacting Qantas Freight Sales Support.
This auto-reply is to confirm that we have received your enquiry and your case number is {!Case.CaseNumber}.
We will get back to you as soon as possible during business hours. If you require further information, please respond to this email.
It is important to ensure you are not emailing or responding to an old email thread that we have actioned previously, as this may result in a delay in responding. If you require immediate support (for example with an urgent booking or in transit freight) we recommend you call Qantas Freight Customer Service on 13 12 13.
All the best, Qantas Freight Sales Support Team
www.qantasfreight.com
